name: AI² Robotics
summary:
AI² Robotics (Zhipingfang) develops general-purpose intelligent robots around its AlphaBot hardware and AlphaBrain embodied AI platform. Founded in April 2023, the company combines model development with robot design, manufacturing, data collection and deployment.

AlphaBrain connects environmental understanding, whole-body coordination and multi-step task planning. The company provides industrial solutions for handling, loading, assembly and equipment operation, as well as commercial interaction and drink preparation. Its development offering includes teleoperation, data collection, simulation and interfaces for robot control. Research, manufacturing, airport services and assisted-living applications are among the areas described in its product and solution portfolio.
